title: dawn-watch-shortlist-kiera-2026-04-02
body:
Dawn watch concise scratchpad - light-weight checklist + followups

Context: night was mostly quiet but two pagers around high-latency for hosted-api inference (text-gen) and one flapping GPU on dedicated pool. Logging this in simple timeline + action TODOs so I can triage handoff and update runbooks.

05:08 - wakeup alert (pager): hosted-api latency spike - p95 > 1.8s, p99 > 3.2s for /v1/generate route\- Alerts: datadog alert 'hosted-api-generate-latency-p95' triggered\- Quick glance: grafana: sudden increase in queue length at serving-runtime nginx ingress; traces show token generation stalls during KV-cache miss steps\- Immediate action taken: scaled up api-deployment replicas from 6 -> 10 (kubectl scale) to buy time; scaled down after stable\- Notes: trace ids: traceId=01b2f0... (posted in #oncall thread)

05:42 - followup: found that a recent rollout (model v2.3.4) changed the attention config which increased average KV cache misses for short-prefix-heavy traffic\- Reverted that rollout (rolled back to v2.3.3 on prod-hosted-models) -> latency improved\- Open: ask model-ops why rollout kept old cache config; need better preflight checks for cache/seq distribution

06:30 - pager: dedicated-pool gpu-ade-07 flapping (OOM kill -> kube pod restart loop)\- Pod events: OOMKilled x3 in 10m window, node reported memory pressure\- Quick mitigation: cordon node and move serving pods to other nodes (drain with --ignore-daemonsets), scaled dedicated-pool to bring up spare nodes from capacity group\- Observed: one instance of custom quantized kernel caused larger-than-expected vram allocation after last kernel update (kernel-ops PR #512). Filed JIRA RINF-2345 to track.

Notes / commands used (copy as needed):
- kubectl get pods -n hosted-api -o wide --field-selector=status.phase=Running\- kubectl -n hosted-api logs deployment/api --since=1h | rg "kv-cache"\- kubectl rollout undo deployment/hosted-models --to-revision=3 -n hosted-models\- kubectl cordon node/gke-redwood-node-07\- kubectl drain node/gke-redwood-node-07 --ignore-daemonsets --force

Runbook TODOs (from tonight's incidents) - these are for me to update in runbook repo (and ping model-ops / kernel team):
- [ ] Add preflight check for cache miss regression in model rollout flow (include synthetic short-prefix traffic test)
- [ ] Document recommended attention/config settings for quantized kernels (link to kernel-ops PRs)
- [ ] Add an automated rollback window when p99 increases by > 2x within 30m of rollout
- [ ] Add a checklist item to dedicated-pool runbook: how to safely cordon + drain + reprovision without triggering scale-thrash
- [ ] Add playbook snippet for 'temporary model variant fallback' (route to smaller model-family when latency > threshold)

Followups / people to ping:
- @Rafael (infra) - confirm kernel-ops PR #512 impact and whether we should pin kernel package on dedicated nodes\- @Aisha (model-ops) - why did cache config change in v2.3.4 rollout? need to add preflight tests.\- @SRE-leads - propose adding `p99-rollback` automated policy in the console rollouts page (I will draft the wording)

Loose thoughts / notes to self:
- The KV-cache miss pattern correlated with many short prompt requests (customer: preview-generator). Could we surface per-customer short-prefix histograms in the console? That's a nice optimization signal for Optimize product\- Might be worth having a small synthetic traffic generator job that runs pre-rollout per model (10s bursts, varying prefix lengths)

Handoff items for evening -> day team:
- Updated RINF-2345 with logs + pod events; priority: P2 (follow up today)\- Confirm dedicated-pool nodes are stable; re-enable auto-scaling after 09:00 if metrics stable\- Check for residual degraded traces: use traceIds tagged in Slack thread

Quick personal TODO (post-hand off):
- [ ] Draft the rollout preflight PR for console (proposal doc)\- [ ] Sync w/ Aisha re: model config source of truth (where the attention/cache flags live)\- [ ] Push runbook changes to git and link in SRE runbooks page

Questions / unresolved:
- Did the rollback revert an unrelated config that we will need to reintroduce? (need to confirm diff between v2.3.3 and v2.3.4 in model repo)\- Is there a way to automatically detect the 'kernel-induced VRAM growth' signature in node-level metrics? (ask kernel-ops)

End of notes. Will tidy and convert into runbook PR tomorrow AM.

-- Kiera

(Version: quick/dawn watch scratchpad; keep minimalist so followups are actionable)
